badges.label: Installs and runs npm or PyPI packages without a fixed version
badges.detail: zotero-mcp-server: installs the newest version each time

badges.label: Changes Zotero settings that aren't its own
badges.detail: Turns Zotero's built-in server back on if you've turned it off

badges.label: Downloads and runs uv's installer when you press Install zotero-cli, if you don't have uv
badges.detail: It comes straight from Astral, who make uv, over an encrypted connection, as it would if you installed it yourself. If you don't have uv, pressing Install zotero-cli in its setup checklist runs uv's install script, then uses uv to install the zotero-mcp-server package, which is listed as its own finding. The checklist item says it installs uv too; the README only shows the manual command. We reviewed version 0.15.0; this release has the same code.
